  "working_thesis": "Hannah Arendt's phenomenological distinctions regarding earth, world, and the embodied senses—specifically through the lens of indoor and outdoor spaces—can help interpret the implications of artificial adaptations to a warming planet (carapace, prosthesis, and enclosure) and reveal both the insights and limits of The Human Condition for addressing contemporary climate politics and inequality.",
